# Working notes <!-- quiet: PARKED TASK - the whole file: a project's own material beside its tasks, carrying no id field at all, which is the whole of the test -->

The other half of the class, and the reason it is in this fixture rather than described in a task.

A project keeps its own material beside its tasks, and the `_` skip is what lets it do that with no
exclusion list to maintain. So this file must stay unreported: it carries no id field at all, which
is the whole of the test. If the parked-task check ever fires on this, it has stopped being a check
on lost work and become a check on where a project puts its notes.
